menu_items.name: Chicken Biryani

menu_items.name: Mutton Biryani

menu_items.name: Paneer Butter Masala

menu_items.name: Butter Naan

menu_items.name: Veg Fried Rice

menu_items.name: Chicken Fried Rice

menu_items.name: Gobi Manchurian

menu_items.name: Gulab Jamun

menu_items.name: Masala Chai
menu_items.description: Freshly brewed hot tea infused with crushed ginger, cardamom, and spices.
